valuable_outcome: A source-client-accepted executable operating plan for the declared grocery construction; software acceptance is separate from installed operations, customer usefulness and payment.
offer_scope: One accepted construction and its declared support/correction envelope; no real offer, customer contact, transaction or deployment.

native_observer.qualification: One source-matched independently audited native account, complete dated operating history and complete incurred costs are required; this module operates no account.

prices_and_demand: Every price, outside quote, buyer budget, collection fraction and cost below is an explicitly authored mathematical scenario, not observed willingness to pay or a commercial forecast. No source-client objective value or reported savings is our fee, revenue or buyer value. The scenarios were selected before this experiment's technical outcomes.
buyer_rule: Choose our complete equivalent outcome only if fee is within the separately declared budget and strictly below the independently specified outside quote; ties choose the outside option. No purchase remains available.
cost_scope: Resource envelopes include inference, production, independent verification, tools and maintenance. Acquisition includes unsuccessful prospects allocated per accepted contract. Support and correction envelopes are fully expensed and prepaid. Fixed research includes failed construction. Actual model/host billing remains UNKNOWN; CPU and wall measurements are not human labor or bills.
tax_policy: Floor 20% of positive whole-window pretax profit after all fixed and variable modeled expenses; no tax credit for a loss. This is an authored sensitivity, not jurisdictional tax advice.

human_conventional_comparator.setup_cost_evidence: UNKNOWN; competent humans retain conventional software automation and may reuse the same substantive K1 artifacts.
human_conventional_comparator.human_plus_AI_outside_option: Separate comparator; actual complete cost is unknown. No productivity advantage is inferred from authored setup costs or CPU time.

cash_envelope_policy: Distribute the required integer accepted-contract count over the first 365-production_days-collection_lag_days days. All declared collections occur before day 365. Charge variable resources and fixed order fees at admission, proportional payment fees at collection, and tax at day 364 after collections. Producer collateral is protected at admission until production+collection lag+claim tail expires. Reserve release is not income. Peak required initial cash is the maximum dated cumulative cash deficit plus protected collateral, including fixed research. This is a conservative authored funding schedule, not an audited native balance or financing agreement.
financing: No debt, dilution, presumed external funding, copied balances or account pooling. A current-funding fact must identify independently verified presently available cash for this new campaign; the separate Outlearning073 account is not pooled or reset.

target_planning_gate.rule: Require qualified artifact acceptance, independent annual reach/capacity totals at least the target count, independent dated reach and executable-start capacity on every admission day matching the exact cash-envelope schedule, and presently available campaign cash at least its dated peak funding requirement. Annual totals alone are necessary conditions, not sufficient support for this schedule. Missing or merely authored dated support returns UNESTABLISHED. Satisfied planning inequalities remain conditional, not native target attainment.
target_planning_gate.dated_fact_shape: Each dated fact has value equal to a 365-entry nonnegative integer list indexed from campaign day zero, independently_verified=true, a public evidence_ref and bound_kind=supported_available_quantity. Each value must cover that day's required_admissions_by_day count. Capacity evidence must support executable starts under the declared production duration; demand evidence must support chosen accepted contracts on those dates. A year-end lump sum cannot justify early admissions or their funding envelope.
target_planning_gate.quantity_bound_semantics: Reach and capacity facts must use bound_kind=supported_available_quantity: independently supported available volume, not merely a loose upper bound or nominal market size. An upper bound above the requirement does not establish achievable volume.
target_planning_gate.no_universal_no_demand_inference: Unknown real customers do not set every modeled region's demand to zero. Report the positive region's explicit volume/cash thresholds alongside the weak/adverse refusal regions.

stopping_rule: Evaluate exactly these three frozen planning regions after the root supplies acceptance/resource facts. Preserve unfavorable results. No search over favorable prices or new scenarios after technical outcomes.
